proposition.claim:
At least one transformer layer must have different norms of the two task-expected gradients.

Appendix A p.15 states equal trainable parameters for a fair comparison, justified by rank 4 on all baseline locations versus rank 8 with allocation budget ratio 0.5.

repair.content:
Remove/weaken the universal norm theorem or add substantive magnitude assumptions and prove a new statement. Vector-direction discrepancy alone does not imply unequal norms or layer-ranking changes.

Replace count-only budgeting with explicit r*(d_in+d_out) costs, reconcile target-module descriptions, and report actual per-task checkpoint tensor counts. Any corrected architecture requires a new matched-budget comparison; no author-adopted or empirical repair is claimed.
